glosses: city council, town council, council (a corporation or body of magistrates in cities and towns, corresponding to mayor and aldermen)

examples.en: Which road goes to city hall?

examples.text: ¿Sabes qué distancia hay de la estación al ayuntamiento?
examples.en: Do you know how far it is from the station to city hall?

examples.text: El ayuntamiento se encuentra en el centro de la ciudad.
examples.en: The city hall is located at the center of the city.
